selection.method: 20 unique seeds sampled without replacement within each pool, sorted for execution; no geography, KEY-5 timing, world, outcome, or exposure screening

collisionAudit.scope: All UTF-8 text files in the authoritative repository checkout, excluding .git, bin, obj, and .godot directories; exact standalone eight-digit integer tokens were checked against all 40 selected seeds. This includes existing F-T1 r2, F-T2, F-T3, F-T4, WP7-WP9, B5 manifests and historical output/seed ledgers present in the checkout.

protocol.analysis: Retain all seed outcomes and censoring; F-T7 filters health rows at/after own KEY-5 and reports pooled expected epidemic-hazard share plus 95% seed-bootstrap interval (20,000 resamples, RNG seed 20261115); F-T6 reports working/dormant/queued/unresolved counts, known staffed denominator, reconciliation, and blockers descriptively.

interpretation.ft6: No approved numeric dormant-rate cutoff. Descriptive diagnostic only.
interpretation.ft7: The 10-14% pooled expected-share band and 95% seed-bootstrap interval containing 12% remain an unapproved draft hypothesis/screen only; do not present as user-approved acceptance bounds. Calibration may assess a draft fit. Holdout stays sealed until the draft candidate/source/pack/binaries are frozen; report results diagnostically and do not promote based on an unapproved rule.
interpretation.med08: Natural route-import effect is inconclusive if no valid route-import attempts are observed; focused keyed-gate evidence is separate.

execution: No build, test, or match is authorized by this preregistration. Final pins and output paths must be added/frozen only after source stabilization and host availability; re-run the collision audit against any manifests added after this preparation.
